exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "don't have to / it's okay if not".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
～なくてもいい
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! ～なくてもいい matches "don't have to / it's okay if not".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is ～なくてもいい.
exercises.explanation: Expresses that doing something is not necessary; it's okay if you don't.
